why.blocked: Blocked by the administrator for every key.
why.adminOnly: Only administrators can use this tool.

keys.title: AI from outside (MCP)
keys.help: A key lets a program such as Claude Code look at your boards over MCP. Each key has its own level, its own boards and its own rights per tool. The key is shown once, when it is made.
keys.off: MCP is switched off on this installation. Only an administrator can switch it on.
keys.offAdmin: MCP is switched off on this installation.
keys.created: This is your key. It is shown only once.
keys.boardsAll: All boards you may see, later ones too
keys.revokeBody: "{{name}}" stops working at once. This cannot be undone.

form.name: Name of the key

levelHelp.read: The program can look at cards, the chronicle and history.
levelHelp.act: The program can also ask to press card buttons. You answer each press in the bell, unless you allow a tool without asking. Dangerous buttons always ask.

form.boardsAll: All boards I may see, later ones too

admin.title: AI from outside (MCP)
admin.help: Programs such as Claude Code can read your boards, and press card buttons after an approval, over MCP. Off until you switch it on.
admin.allowedHelp: When off, no key works and the endpoint answers as if it did not exist.
admin.maxLevelHelp: No key goes above it, keys that already exist included.
admin.oauthHelp: A program such as Claude can ask a signed-in person for access instead of being given a key.
admin.blockedHelp: A blocked tool is gone for every key: it is not listed, and it answers like a tool that does not exist.
admin.keysHelp: The keys of every account. Revoking one ends it at once.
admin.revokeBody: "{{name}}" of {{user}} stops working at once. This cannot be undone.

request.title: Approval request
request.heading: {{program}} asks to press a button
request.help: Nothing happens until you answer. Allow runs exactly what is shown below. The request runs out after ten minutes.
request.helpDone: This request has been dealt with.
request.conflict: This request was already answered or has run out.

status.failed: Allowed, but it did not work

connect.title: Connect a program
connect.heading: {{program}} wants to connect to your nexdeck
connect.help: The program gets a key of its own. It sees only what you choose here, it shows in your list of keys under Settings, and you can revoke it there at any time.
connect.check: Only allow this if you started connecting in the program yourself and you recognise the address it returns to.

error.off: Connectors are not allowed on this installation. Only an administrator can allow them.
error.client: This program is not registered here. Start connecting again in the program.
error.redirect: The program wants to return to an address it did not register. Nothing was sent to it.
error.request: The request of the program is incomplete or meant for another server. Start connecting again in the program.
error.session: Sign in with your password to connect a program.
error.tooMany: Your account holds the most keys it may have. Revoke one under Settings first.
